{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Omni-Directional_Sensor_Globe.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An Omni-directional sensor globe]]
An '''Omni-directional sensor globe''' was a ground-based [[Full-spectrum transceiver/Legends|full-spectrum transceiver]] and early warning [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]], providing basic information on approaching ground and space forces by scanning the area around and above the sensor.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> One of the [[sensor globe]]s rested in [[Nebit/Legends|Nebit's]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]], near a pair of [[KPR security droid/Legends|KPR servant droids]].
